instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Titan Group operates a telemedicine platform connecting patients with GPs and specialists for video consultations, e-prescriptions, and remote monitoring. With 500+ credentialed physicians on the platform and 120,000 completed consultations, the company is regulated as a Class I medical device by relevant national bodies. The organization functions across multiple departments with formalized quarterly business reviews and dedicated strategy input, though digital integration between core systems remains fragmented.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer developed an internal dashboard to visualize the order backlog for operations, which was initially useful but lacked formal compliance validation. Due to the lack of institutional support and a clear maintenance plan within our informal structure, the project stalled when the lead developer left, highlighting a critical gap in idea lifecycle management.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core telemedicine business is stable but faces market saturation. We are actively exploring adjacent business models such as a pharmacy marketplace or premium data subscription services built on our proprietary patient interaction data. The goal is to diversify revenue streams while maintaining compliance and focusing on long-term sustainable growth.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently under pressure to formalize its digital infrastructure without incurring excessive compliance risks, making structured innovation efforts essential.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Triage Optimization for Specialist Routing
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a moderate AI model to autonomously triages incoming patient symptoms and recommends the optimal specialist pathway would improve operational efficiency within existing regulatory frameworks. This is an incremental step that reduces manual workload without requiring fundamental system overhauls.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on current data pipeline readiness for AI ingestion.
Define scope and compliance requirements (FDA/local body input).
Allocate 5% of R&D budget for a proof-of-concept pilot.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10% reduction in specialist routing time within the pilot cohort.
milestones: Q3: Data pipeline audit complete and scope finalized.

opportunities.title: Adjacency Market Entry: Specialty Tele-Pharmacy Marketplace
opportunities.rationale: Expanding into a marketplace model for prescription fulfillment and over-the-counter health products represents a significant diversification opportunity. While highly competitive, it leverages existing patient data to create new revenue streams outside the core consultation service.

first_actions: Identify 3 key regulatory jurisdictions for pilot entry.
Develop legal framework and partner agreements with pharmacy chains.
Establish a minimum viable product (MVP) focused solely on prescription ordering.
resources_needed: Legal counsel specializing in pharmaceutical regulations ($50k)
Small marketing budget for initial launch
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 anchor pharmacy partners and achieve $5M in transaction volume within the first year.
milestones: Q1: Regulatory approval secured in pilot state.

next_steps.action: Formalize the innovation intake process and establish a cross-functional Steering Committee for diversification projects.
Develop a detailed business model canvas for 'Data Monetization' using proprietary patient data, identifying specific compliance pathways.

key_weaknesses: Fragmented and informal innovation pipeline leading to high project attrition.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) impeding scalable integration needed for new business models.
Lack of formalized strategy translating broad diversification goals into specific, executable product roadmaps.
High internal regulatory compliance burden creating a friction point in rapid prototyping.
